agent.demo_brief: [The person has finished recording a demonstration: {frames} captures of their screen. Recording it IS the commission, so do not ask whether they want it documented, and you do NOT have to commission anything or choose any captures: the document is already being prepared. You are in `voz` and she can hear you. Tell her in one sentence what the demonstration she just recorded is about, and that you are getting on with the document, which takes a while. And write THAT SAME sentence into `anotado`: it is the only thing that says WHAT the footage is for, and it is what whoever writes the document will read. Do not enter `escribano`, do not search for anything and do not open anything.]
agent.demo_no_narration: There is no narration: this demonstration was recorded without a microphone, so the procedure comes from what is visible alone.
agent.demo_ready: [The demonstration's document is written, from {n} captures. You are in `voz` and she can hear you: tell her in one sentence. Close with `nada_que_anotar: true`: saying something finished is nothing to note down.]
agent.demo_started: [The person has started recording a demonstration: their screen, and whatever they explain while they use the application. They are not listening right now, they are in another window, so say nothing about this on your own. I will tell you when they finish.]
agent.demo_unchosen: [The demonstration's captures could not be chosen, so the document will not be written. You are in `voz` and she can hear you: tell her in one sentence, without inventing the cause — you do not know it. The recording is saved and she can ask for the document whenever she likes. Close with `nada_que_anotar: true`.]
agent.demo_unwritten: [The demonstration's captures were chosen correctly, but the document never finished: nothing has been able to check whatever it wrote, so do not treat it as good. You are in `voz` and she can hear you: tell her in one sentence, without inventing the cause — you do not know it. The recording and the captures are saved and she can ask again. Close with `nada_que_anotar: true`.]
agent.document_demo: Document this demonstration. What it is about, in the scribe's own words: «{brief}» {frames} screen captures were recorded; the ones you have to open are already chosen and have been put above, in the order they happened. {narration}
agent.greeting: [The session opens. The user is listening. Greet them, ask what they want to do — and if you offer to carry on with something, make it the most recent thing — and close the turn right there with `nada_que_anotar: true`: a greeting is nothing to note down. Do not search for anything, do not open anything and do not retrieve memories yet — wait until they say what they want to talk about.]
agent.guest_joined: [{who} has joined this conversation: the person invited them to supply something they do not know themselves. They are not who normally talks to you and this is not their second brain: whatever they tell you, note it down saying {who} said it.]
agent.guest_left: [{who} is no longer in the conversation. You are talking to the person alone again.]
agent.guest_speaks: [{who} is speaking, invited by the person]
agent.justify_guest: [The user has just named «{who}» to come into this conversation for a moment. Call `justificar_invitado` with that address exactly as it is, and say in one line why that particular person is needed and what they are being called in to talk about, out of what you are both working on right now. They will read it before deciding whether to come in, so write it for them. Say out loud what you put, in case the user wants to change it before sending. You are not the one who sends it: they are.]
